verdict.rationale: Goodwin's locations page says it operates from 18 of its own offices across North America, Europe and Asia, naming London, Munich, Paris, Luxembourg, Brussels, Hong Kong and Singapore. Its privacy practice page also cites specialists across the United States and Europe. missing for 10: independent corroboration of the office footprint, and per-country detail on which local-law practices (e.g., corporate or venture) are qualified in each non-US office.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm states its own offices or qualified practices in multiple countries, so expansion does not immediately mean a second firm

citations.quote: Our lawyers and business professionals operate from 18 offices across North America, Europe, and Asia
